limits: Laboratory placement and deterministic scripted policies; no human win-rate or playtime claim.
Normal cohort is actual main-only prepared save. Optimized uses its owned gear and allocated points only.
Unarmed literally removes weapons; starter retains the zero-attack starting weapon so legal attacks/skills can be compared.

Live production XP, drops, level-up healing and collision remain enabled. Three seeds are a diagnosis, not statistical certification.
